datasets.title: Integrated extracellular microRNA profiling for uterine sarcomas
datasets._de61c0: 本数据由索臻生物科技(SOGEN)标注·免费共享欢迎转发·想要增量更新请加群·微信bioinformaticsboy
datasets.summary: MicroRNAs stably exist in the peripheral blood and can be potential biomarkers. In this study, we evaluated the serum miRNA profiles of patients with uterine sarcomas.
datasets.overall_design: Serum samples of 30 women, which consist of leiomyosarcoma, adenosarcoma, endometrial stromal sarcoma (ESS), uterine smooth muscle tumors of uncertain malignant potential (STUMP), and leiomyoma, were used. Serum miRNA profiles were investigated using 3D-Gene® RNA extraction reagent from liquid sample kit (Toray Industries, Inc.).
datasets.study_design: 子宫平滑肌肉瘤、腺肉瘤、ESS等患者血清miRNA芯片谱分析，比较不同肿瘤类型miRNA差异
datasets.relevance_reason: 包含子宫平滑肌肉瘤、腺肉瘤、ESS患者血清miRNA表达数据

evidence.relevant: 研究子宫肉瘤患者血清miRNA谱作为生物标志物，样本来自平滑肌肉瘤、腺肉瘤、ESS等患者，主体与样本均明确为该疾病。
evidence.sequencing_type: GEO数据类型为Non-coding RNA profiling by array，标题和摘要明确研究血清miRNA，样本提取总RNA后通过芯片杂交检测miRNA表达谱，无测序步骤。
evidence.survival_analysis: 无生存时间或生存状态字段，摘要亦未提及生存随访，无法进行Kaplan-Meier分析
evidence.treatment: 核心比较为不同子宫肿瘤类型的miRNA谱，无药物干预对照轴
evidence.case_vs_control_differential: 所有样本均为子宫肿瘤患者（含良性平滑肌瘤），缺乏独立的健康对照，无法做疾病vs正常差异分析
evidence.correlation: 子宫肉瘤患者仅9例（LMS 5、腺肉瘤2、ESS 2），不足16例，无法进行可靠的疾病样本相关性分析
evidence.sample_source: 30个GSM source均为Serum，直接提取总RNA测miRNA芯片，属外周血直接组分，未分选细胞或体外培养，归blood。

datasets.title: Small RNA sequencing for leiomyosarcoma cells and their extracellular vesicles
datasets._12262e: 数据来自SOGEN索臻标注语料·sogentech.com·更多学科与专题私域群持续更新·微信bioinformaticsboy
datasets.summary: Uterine leiomyosarcoma is a rare malignant tumor and has a poor prognosis even during its early stages. Extracellular vesicles (EVs) carry cargo, such as microRNAs (miRNAs), which are involved in intercellular communication in the tumor microenvironment and other processes. EVs are classified based on their biogenesis mechanism, and small EVs have a diameter of less than 200 nm, whereas medium/large EVs have a diameter of 200 nm or greater. This study investigated the expression of miRNAs in leiomyosarcoma cells and their EVs.
datasets.overall_design: SKN and SK-LMS-1 cells were cultured, and small and medium/large EVs were purified using the ultracentrifuge. Then, total RNA was extracted, and small RNA sequencing was performed.
datasets.study_design: 子宫平滑肌肉瘤细胞系SKN和SK-LMS-1及其小/中-大EVs的miRNA-seq比较
datasets.relevance_reason: 使用子宫平滑肌肉瘤细胞系SKN和SK-LMS-1

evidence.relevant: 子宫平滑肌肉瘤是子宫肉瘤的一种亚型，数据集研究其细胞与细胞外囊泡中的miRNA表达，研究主体与样本均为该疾病。
evidence.sequencing_type: library_strategy=miRNA-Seq，library_selection=size fractionation富集小RNA，比对到miRbase21确认测miRNA，bulk水平，符合miRNA-seq。
evidence.survival_analysis: 样本全部为细胞系及其EVs，无人类患者样本，无生存时间/状态字段
evidence.treatment: 核心比较轴为细胞系类型与EV亚群，无药物或治疗干预对照
evidence.case_vs_control_differential: 全部样本为平滑肌肉瘤细胞系及其EVs，无独立健康对照组织或细胞
evidence.correlation: 总样本数仅6，均为细胞系来源，无≥16例独立疾病患者样本
evidence.sample_source: 全部6样本为已建系平滑肌肉瘤细胞系SKN和SK-LMS-1及其培养上清分离的小EV和中/大EV，均属细胞系来源。
